U0401.title: Invalid Data Received from ECM/PCM
U0401.description: The ECM/PCM is present on the data bus but the values it reports are implausible — out of range, frozen, or failing the checksum or rolling-count check. U0406.title: Invalid Data Received From Fuel Injector Control Module
U0406.description: U0406 means a receiving controller, normally the ECM/PCM, gets messages from the fuel injector control module that arrive but fail its checks: wrong counter, checksum, range or a signal marked invalid. Ford's 2012 OBD summary shows the U04xx principle with U0401: the TCM stores it when the ECM sends invalid or faulted torque or pedal data. A separate injector module exists only on some designs; GM's 2013 bi-fuel CNG Silverado/Sierra uses an FICM that switches the injectors and passes rail pressure and temperature to the ECM over serial data. No manufacturer documents U0406 publicly. As fuel delivery affects emissions, CARB requires such inputs to be monitored and a MIL is likely. U0105 means lost contact, U0306 a software mismatch.

causes.label: Corroded or loose connector, damaged bus wire to the injector module
Low supply voltage at the injector module
Software levels of injector module and ECM do not match
Injector control module internally faulty

symptoms: Check engine light on
Rough running, misfire or hard start
Reduced power

U0407.title: Invalid Data Received From Glow Plug Control Module
U0407.description: U0407 is stored when the engine controller receives data from the glow plug control module that it rejects as implausible. Volkswagen lists the code in the 2014 Touareg diesel OBD chart as Invalid Data Received From Glow Plug Control Module 1, criterion implausible messages received. On that engine the glow unit talks to the ECM over LIN; VW uses U0106 for a missing LIN message and U0307 for a failed software check, which separates the three siblings clearly. Ford's 2012 OBD summary shows the same U04xx idea for other modules: data arrive but are faulted. Because the glow module also reports plug faults, invalid data can hide real glow plug problems. Expect hard cold starts, white smoke and on a diesel usually the MIL.

causes.label: LIN wire or connector between glow module and ECM corroded or loose
Glow plug control module internally faulty
Voltage dip during glow check or cranking
Glow module software does not match the ECM

symptoms: Check engine or glow plug light on
Hard starting in cold weather
White smoke and rough idle after cold start

U0408.title: Invalid Data Received From Throttle Actuator Control Module
U0408.description: U0408 points to messages from the throttle actuator control module that the receiver, usually the ECM/PCM, judges invalid: implausible content, a failed checksum or counter, or a value outside its range. Most vehicles integrate throttle control in the engine controller, so a separate TAC module and therefore this code are uncommon; no manufacturer documents U0408 publicly. Ford's 2012 OBD summary illustrates the U04xx logic with U0401, which the TCM stores when ECM torque or pedal data are faulted. Because the throttle meters intake air, CARB's comprehensive component rules apply, and a MIL together with reduced power or a limp mode is likely. U0107 means lost contact, U0308 a software mismatch with the same module.

causes.label: Damaged bus wire or poor connector contact at the throttle module
Throttle actuator control module internally faulty
Software of throttle module and ECM do not match
Low or unstable supply voltage

symptoms: Check engine light on
Limp mode with reduced throttle response
Unstable idle or stalling

U0409.title: Invalid Data Received From Alternative Fuel Control Module
U0409.description: U0409 is logged when the engine controller receives data from the alternative fuel control module that fail its validity checks. Such a module runs the gas side of bi-fuel CNG or LPG vehicles. In Ford's 2000 bi-fuel OBD description the AFCM passes the requested mode (ALT or GAS) and supply status between the gas metering unit and the PCM, which then switches the petrol injectors on or off; GM's 2013 CNG Silverado/Sierra sends rail pressure and temperature from its injector module to the ECM over serial data. No manufacturer documents U0409 publicly. Corrupt data can make the engine fall back to petrol or misjudge gas pressure, so CARB monitoring applies and a MIL is likely. U0108 means lost contact, U0309 a software mismatch.

causes.label: Corroded connector or damaged wiring of the retrofit or factory gas system
Faulty gas rail pressure/temperature sensor delivering implausible values
Alternative fuel control module faulty or wrongly configured

symptoms: Check engine light on
Engine stays on or switches back to petrol
Gas gauge or fuel mode indicator incorrect

U0410.title: Invalid Data Received From Fuel Pump Control Module
U0410.description: U0410 means the engine controller receives data from the fuel pump control module that it cannot trust, such as a bad checksum, counter or an out-of-range value. Many cars drive the in-tank pump through such a module to set the low-side pressure on demand. GM shows why the data matter for emissions: bulletin PIP5427 (2014-2016 trucks and SUVs) traces a lit service engine lamp and a fuel pressure deviation P2635 to communication faults between ECM and pump module, logged there as U0074 or GM's own U18A2. From 2014 GM renamed this unit chassis control module. No manufacturer documents U0410 publicly. Expect a MIL, hesitation or reduced power. U0109 means lost contact, U0310 a software mismatch.

causes.label: Damaged bus wire or corroded connector to the fuel pump module (often near the tank)
Poor power or ground of the fuel pump module
Pump module and ECM software do not match after replacement
Fuel pump control module internally faulty

symptoms: Check engine light on
Fuel pressure codes such as P2635 set together
Hesitation, stalling or reduced power

U0411.title: Invalid Data Received From Drive Motor Control Module
U0411.description: U0411 is stored when a controller, typically the engine or hybrid controller, receives messages from the drive motor control module (the inverter electronics of an electric traction motor) that it judges invalid. Volkswagen lists it in its 2014 hybrid OBD charts: for the Touareg Hybrid on implausible messages from the motor module, for the Jetta Hybrid on an incorrect CAN data length code. Bentley's Flying Spur Hybrid (2022-2023) stores U041100 in the engine control unit with a warning lamp, partly together with P0A2E for the motor temperature sensor circuit, and has the technician measure and inspect a harness connector. U0110 means lost contact, U0311 a software mismatch. Hybrid drive may be limited or switched off.

causes.label: Damaged pins or poor contact in harness connectors near the drive motor (Bentley case)
Faulty motor temperature sensor circuit making the module send invalid data
Software of motor module and hybrid controller do not match
Drive motor control module internally faulty

symptoms: Engine or drive system warning light on
Electric drive unavailable, engine runs constantly
Reduced power

U0412.title: Invalid Data Received From Battery Energy Control Module A
U0412.description: U0412 is stored when the hybrid or engine controller receives data from battery energy control module A, the management unit of the high-voltage battery, that it rejects as invalid. Volkswagen's 2014 Jetta Hybrid OBD chart sets it on implausible received data. FCA lists U0412-00 for the 2019 Chrysler Pacifica plug-in hybrid (TSB 08-114-22) among codes that light the MIL and can remain as permanent codes, so the vehicle fails a state smog check; the fix is new software for the hybrid control processors, not a battery part. CARB requires emission-related control units to be monitored, which explains the MIL. U0111 means lost contact, U0413 covers module B, U0312 a software mismatch. Charging or electric driving may be limited.

causes.label: Software error in hybrid controller or battery management (FCA: reflash HCP/AHCP)
Bus wiring or connector fault between battery module and hybrid controller
Weak 12 V battery disturbing module start-up
Battery energy control module internally faulty

symptoms: Check engine light on, code may become permanent
Charging or electric driving limited
Hybrid system warning message

U0413.title: Invalid Data Received From Battery Energy Control Module B
U0413.description: U0413 is the counterpart of U0412 for battery energy control module B, used where the high-voltage battery has a second management unit or a split controller. Volkswagen's 2014 Jetta Hybrid chart sets it on implausible data, while the 2014 Touareg Hybrid chart uses U0413 for its single battery module, which shows that the A/B assignment is maker-specific. Audi stores U041300 in the engine and electric drive controllers of the Q5 and A7 plug-in hybrids (model years 2019-2022) together with a drive system warning; the cause was software in the battery management and its junction box, cured by an update. U0112 means lost contact, U0313 a software mismatch, U0412 covers module A. Electric driving may be restricted.

causes.label: Software error in battery management or junction box (Audi: SVM update)
Bus wiring or connector fault at the battery module
Battery energy control module B internally faulty

symptoms: Drive system or engine warning light on
Electric driving or charging restricted
Code stored in engine and electric drive controllers

causes.label: Module internal fault or sensor input drift
Software version mismatch after replacement
Gateway module routing CAN messages incorrectly

symptoms: Multiple warning lights may illuminate
Affected modules may go into limp mode or shut down
Specific functions inoperative depending on module
Diagnostic tools may show communication faults
